title: AuthPolicy
description: Organization-level authentication policy (singleton). Governs SSO join rules and local accounts.

requireInviteForSSO.description: When true, SSO users must have a valid invitation to join the org (JIT is disabled).

allowLocalAccounts.description: When true, non-SSO accounts (e.g., bootstrap/break-glass) are allowed.

defaultRoleSlugsOnJIT.description: Role slugs to grant automatically on first SSO sign-in (if enabled). Each slug must exist in the org.

approvalRequiredOnFirstSSO.description: Future-use flag. When true, first-time SSO users enter a pending state and require admin approval before access.
